_note: Biscuits: ported from research/NotebookLM/rule_engine.py (verified source). All other categories below (bread, milk_powder, laundry_soap, toilet_soap, detergent_powder, edible_oil, rice, bottled_water, cement) are from secondary research artifacts (research/mainResearch/ docx files) and are UNVERIFIED against the actual gazetted Second Schedule text. Each such category is marked _verified: false. get_second_schedule_categories() (backend/lmd/dsl/registry.py) excludes any _verified: false subtype from system.second_schedule_list, so LM-M04a / LM-M04b evaluate to NOT_APPLICABLE -- never BLOCKER/MAJOR -- for unverified categories. Do NOT flip a category to _verified: true until it has been cross-checked against the official Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules 2011 Second Schedule gazette.

bread._note: 100 g multiples described in docx; terminal bound not stated in source

milk_powder._note: 50 g steps up to 5 kg described in docx; list may not be exhaustive

detergent_powder._note: 50 g steps up to 2 kg described in docx

edible_oil._note: 50 g/ml steps up to 5 kg/L; values in ml below

rice._note: 100/200 g steps up to 5 kg described in docx

bottled_water._note: 100/200/500 ml and 1 L described in docx; values in ml below

cement._note: 1-25 kg, 40 kg (white cement), 50 kg described in docx; values in g below
